candidates.statement: The Australian standard 2025 KX450 has published displacement of 449 cc.

candidates.locator: MODEL SPECS > POWER > Bore x Stroke
candidates.statement: The Australian standard 2025 KX450 lists bore 96.0 mm and stroke 62.1 mm.

candidates.locator: MODEL SPECS > POWER > Primary Reduction Ratio
candidates.statement: The Australian standard 2025 KX450 lists primary reduction 2.727 (60/22).

candidates.locator: MODEL SPECS > POWER > Final Reduction Ratio
candidates.statement: The Australian standard 2025 KX450 lists final reduction 3.846 (50/13).

conflicts.resolution: Do not infer a regional engineering difference or publish a universal compression ratio. Require regional OEM manual and revision verification.
